To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the automatic parallelization of ANSI C programs to CUDA C programs is a feasible task and the resulting code performs well.

• The GAP is an automatic parallelizer that translates sequential ANSI C code into parallel CUDA C programs • The GAP parallelization is based on the data flow analysis and is implemented using a combination of static analysis and dynamic compilation • The GAP is capable of parallelizing programs with complex control flow, including nested loops, conditional branches and function calls • The GAP is able to generate efficient parallel programs that are capable of achieving speed-ups of up to 100x for programs that expose high data parallelism.
